description: This file contains test cases for the 'litellm' project, specifically testing the spend logging payload generation and request body sanitization functions within the test directory.

classes.name: litellm.ModelResponse
classes.description: Represents a model response object with attributes for id, choices, created timestamp, model name, object type, and usage details.

classes.name: litellm.Choices
classes.description: Represents individual choices within a model response, including finish reason, index, message content, and role.

classes.name: litellm.Message
classes.description: Represents a message with content and role, used within a choices object.

classes.name: litellm.Usage
classes.description: Contains token usage details: prompt tokens, completion tokens, and total tokens.

methods.name: test_spend_logs_payload(model_id: Optional[str])
methods.description: Tests the generation of spend logs payload with a typical model response, checking key fields and metadata integrity.

methods.name: test_spend_logs_payload_whisper()
methods.description: Tests payload creation for transcription responses, ensuring correct response and spend amount logging.

methods.name: test_spend_logs_payload_with_prompts_enabled(monkeypatch)
methods.description: Validates inclusion of message and response content in logs when prompts are configured to be stored.

methods.name: test_large_request_no_truncation_threshold()
methods.description: Verifies that large request bodies are truncated according to MAX_STRING_LENGTH_PROMPT_IN_DB, preserving start and end segments.

methods.name: test_small_request_no_truncation()
methods.description: Ensures small request payloads below the threshold are not truncated.

methods.name: test_configurable_string_length_env_var(monkeypatch)
methods.description: Checks that environment variable configuration for MAX_STRING_LENGTH_PROMPT_IN_DB is effective.

methods.name: test_truncation_preserves_beginning_and_end()
methods.description: Confirms truncation maintains the start (35%) and end (65%) of large content for clarity and debugging.
